title: Decimal places 0 is a real value: compare formatting.decimalPlaces against null, never by truthiness
answers: Decimal places set to 0 does nothing on a SQL insight
table cell ignores zero decimal places under style None
body:
Symptom: setting Decimal places to 0 on a SQL insight (style None) has no effect; Big number and table cells show 42.195 instead of 42. The Number style rounded correctly because toLocaleString accepts maximumFractionDigits 0.
Root cause: frontend/src/queries/nodes/DataVisualization/dataVisualizationLogic.ts:formatDataWithSettings and the tabularData cell selector used `decimalPlaces ? ...` / `if (formatting?.decimalPlaces)`, and 0 is falsy.
Fix pattern: use `decimalPlaces != null` (or `?? 3` as in sqlLineGraphAdapter.ts:formatSqlSeriesValue). Do NOT use `toFixed(decimalPlaces ?? 0)` in formatDataWithSettings: unset must keep full precision (a test asserts 42.5 stays '42.5').
Constraints: the table cell selector also skips decimal-places formatting when style is 'short' (a retained decimalPlaces is ignored, matching the settings panel; short 12.345 -> '12.3'). Apply the same null check to any new site that reads formatting.decimalPlaces.
